dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: At 11:49 PM, Daniel Cross was worth fourteen point seven billion dollars.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: At 11:49 PM, he thought he had everything money could buy.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Because the Ledger had already written his name down.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Riven had collected thousands of souls.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: He never cared how rich they were.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Death did not negotiate with bank accounts.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: But tonight, the Ledger felt different.

dialogue.speaker: Riven
dialogue.text: Someone who already knows how this ends.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Ten minutes is a long time when you are waiting for something.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: It is a very short time when you finally understand what you wasted.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: For the first time in years, Daniel stopped thinking about money.

dialogue.speaker: Riven
dialogue.text: Until the part you cannot buy.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: There was one name he had not called in three years.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: He had sent money instead of apologies so many times that money had started to feel like an apology.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: I just... wanted to hear your voice.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: He had seen people beg for more time before.

dialogue.line_id: S05 â€” What Money Couldn't Fix_L031
dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: He had rarely seen anyone use it honestly.

dialogue.line_id: S05 â€” What Money Couldn't Fix_L032
dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: I thought giving you everything would make up for not being there.

dialogue.line_id: S05 â€” What Money Couldn't Fix_L033
dialogue.speaker: Daughter

NARRATOR
dialogue.text: The time beside Daniel's name flickered.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: An appointed death was not supposed to change because a man finally said what he should have said years ago.

dialogue.speaker: Riven
dialogue.text: That is not how this works.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Riven had a choice he was never supposed to have.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Or he could find out why the entry had changed.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Riven gave Daniel one more minute.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Because something had altered the Ledger.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: And Riven needed to know who—or what—was behind it.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: At 11:59 PM, Daniel's phone was still in his hand.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: His daughter was still on the line.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: And the Ledger was still open.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Daniel had been given ten minutes.

dialogue.line_id: S10 â€” The Time You Wasted_L068
dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Maybe they had changed his fate.

dialogue.line_id: S10 â€” The Time You Wasted_L069
dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: Maybe they had only delayed it.

dialogue.text: Ten minutes is not the time you were given.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: It is the time you wasted.
